doc: bsv-low #831 (the FIX-831-B lens's MEDIUM-2): the D1 ceilings of the retire pass on a populated overlay D1 (tools/lane-831/retire_pass_budget_ci.mjs, make ci-d1-budget). The pass's statements are bounded by its own budget (480, and its three tail statements past it), and which candidates a pass reaches moves with the clock (both rotations), so the statement ceiling is the budget's bound plus 7, not a measured figure plus 2; reads, writes and the largest statement are the worst measured over the worst tick and the drain, x 1.5. Raise one only with a new measurement and its reason.
